meta.desc: Tzach Zrihan is an independent wedding producer in Israel — the happiest one you'll ever meet. Full planning 5–10 months before the big day, real savings, total peace of mind on the day itself.

manifesto.h2:
Just engaged?
Excited — and completely lost.
manifesto.body: Everyone gives you different advice, and you have no idea where to start. I bring order, savings and a calm mind — with a lot of love and real friendship between me and the couples I work with. Because by the end, I'm not just your wedding producer. I'm your friend through the whole process.

items.q: Why do I need an independent wedding producer?
items.a: An independent wedding producer (מפיק חתונות חיצוני) works for you — not for the venue. Unlike the in-house coordinator provided by the hall, I'm entirely on your side: I negotiate vendors, manage your budget, and am present on the day itself to make sure everything goes exactly as planned. <!-- To be completed with client's approved answer -->
